text:
Platform sync, 12 March.
Sarah will finish the API integration by Thursday.
Dan will review the migration script afterwards.

questions.question: Who owns the API integration?
By when must the API integration be finished?

full_zh:
平台同步会议，3月12日。
Sarah将在周四前完成API集成。
Dan随后会审核迁移脚本。

text:
Release planning, 4 June.
The deadline for the billing rollout moved from Thursday to Friday.
Priya confirmed the new date with the vendor.

questions.question: What is the current deadline for the billing rollout?
What was the previous deadline for the billing rollout?

full_zh:
发布计划，6月4日。
计费上线的截止日期从周四改到了周五。
Priya已与供应商确认了新日期。

text:
Architecture review, 9 April.
John did not agree with Sarah about the caching layer.
No decision was recorded; the team will revisit next week.

facts.statement: John did not agree with Sarah

questions.question: Did John agree with Sarah about the caching layer? Answer YES or NO.
Was a decision recorded about the caching layer? Answer YES or NO.

full_zh: 架构评审，4月9日。John不同意Sarah关于缓存层的意见。未记录任何决定；团队将在下周重新讨论。

text:
Metrics review, 21 May.
Checkout conversion rose from 13% to 30% after the redesign.
Infrastructure spend was 1.5M dollars for the quarter.

questions.question: What is the current checkout conversion rate?
What was the infrastructure spend for the quarter?

full_zh: 指标审查，21 May。重新设计后，结账转化率从13%上升到30%。本季度基础设施支出为1.5M美元。

text:
Staffing sync, 2 February.
Alice owns the search reindex. Alicia owns the billing export.
They report status on alternate weeks.

questions.question: Who owns the search reindex?
Who owns the billing export?

full_zh:
人员配置同步会议，2月2日。
Alice 负责搜索重新索引。Alicia 负责账单导出。
他们每隔一周汇报一次状态。

text:
Delivery standup, 17 July.
The data export is blocked on the schema migration.
Miguel is unblocked and continues on the search reindex.

questions.question: What is the data export blocked on?
Is Miguel blocked? Answer YES or NO.

full_zh: 交付站会，17 July。数据导出受阻于schema迁移。Miguel已解除阻塞，继续处理search reindex。

text:
Go/no-go, 8 October.
If load testing passes by Wednesday, the team ships on Friday.
Otherwise the release slips to the following sprint.

questions.question: On what condition does the team ship on Friday?

full_zh: Go/no-go, 8 October. 如果负载测试在Wednesday之前通过，团队在Friday发布。否则发布推迟到下一个sprint。

text:
Vendor call, 14 January.
Sarah said John would finish the contract review.
She will send the summary once he is done.

questions.question: Who will finish the contract review?
Who will send the summary?

full_zh: 供应商电话会议，1月14日。Sarah说John会完成合同审查。他完成后她会发送摘要。

text:
Ops review, 3 June.
The audit is due next Thursday, not this Thursday.
Nadia will circulate the checklist beforehand.

questions.question: When is the audit due?

full_zh: 运营评审，6月3日。审计截止日期是下周四，不是这个周四。Nadia将提前分发检查清单。

text:
Incident debrief, 30 June.
Initially the team reported the outage lasted 13 minutes.
The final report corrected this to 30 minutes.

questions.question: What was the final reported outage duration?

full_zh:
事件复盘，6月30日。

最初，团队报告中断持续了13分钟。

最终报告将这一时间修正为30分钟。

text:
Partnership sync, 11 September.
Acme and Northwind agreed to a joint pilot starting in Q4.
Legal sign-off is owned by Acme.

questions.question: Which two organizations agreed to the joint pilot?
Who owns legal sign-off?

full_zh: 合作伙伴同步会议，11 September。Acme 和 Northwind 同意在 Q4 启动联合试点。法律签署由 Acme 负责。

text:
Portfolio review, 25 August.
Project A is 40% complete and owned by Rafael.
Project B is 4% complete and owned by Hana.

questions.question: Who owns Project B?
What percent complete is Project A?

full_zh: 投资组合审查，8月25日。项目A完成度40%，由Rafael负责。项目B完成度4%，由Hana负责。
